title: ASIC RG 227
pages:
A Overview
RG 227.1 This guide is for issuers of over-the-counter (OTC) contracts for difference (CFDs) and similar products offered to retail investors.
RG 227.2 It sets out seven disclosure benchmarks that issuers should address in their Product Disclosure Statement.
B Disclosure benchmarks
RG 227.20 Benchmark 1 — Client qualification: the issuer maintains and applies a written client qualification policy.
